section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses the genetic and environmental influences on creative achievement, specifically differentiating between artistic and scientific domains. It highlights that most of the covariance between intelligence and creative achievement, as well as openness and creative achievement, can be attributed to shared genetic factors. A key difference noted is the higher shared genetic variance between intelligence and scientific creative achievement (58%) compared to artistic creative achievement (33%).
